{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check the first few rows of revenue to confirm it's string with commas
print("First few values of revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].head())

# Check for the presence of thousands separators
print("\nUnique values in revenue:")
print(sales['revenue'].unique()[:10])  # Show first 10 unique values

# Confirm if any contain commas
has_commas = sales['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False).any()
print(f"\nDoes revenue contain commas? {has_commas}")"}
